name: Fenwick Thatros
summary: In the Undercity, Mennet Carkad sends promising rogues after Fenwick Thatros on Lord Varimathras's orders. Thatros is suspected of organizing independent undead forces along Silverpine Forest's shores. Killing him proves an operative's mettle to the Deathstalkers and opens the way to advanced trade training.

sections.title: A Command from the Dreadlord
sections.body: In the Undercity's Rogues' Quarter, Mennet Carkad handles Deathstalker contracts and training. The Deathstalkers are the Forsaken's secretive intelligence wing. Lord Varimathras has named Fenwick Thatros as a priority target, a charge too serious for novice recruits. Thatros has established a foothold among rogue undead in Silverpine Forest. If left alone, their independent leadership could threaten Forsaken control across Lordaeron's old holdings.

sections.title: The Decrepit Dock on Lordamere
sections.body: Deathstalker scouts report Fenwick Thatros near a decrepit dock on Lake Lordamere in Silverpine Forest. Reaching him means crossing wilderness claimed by feral beasts, Rot Hide gnolls, and Scourge remnants. Varimathras demands proof of the kill: Thatros's severed head. Bringing it back can earn an operative entry into deeper covert operations.

faq.answer: Fenwick Thatros leads undead near Lake Lordamere in Silverpine Forest. He commands pockets of undead who are unaligned with or hostile to the Undercity, unlike Forsaken who serve Lady Sylvanas. Lord Varimathras has marked him for execution.

faq.q: Why does Varimathras want Fenwick Thatros dead?
faq.answer: Varimathras wants Fenwick Thatros dead because he could rally stray undead in Silverpine against the Forsaken. Rival leaders who threaten Sylvanas's control over the region must be eliminated to secure the Undercity's borders.

The Deathstalkers are the Forsaken's espionage, assassination, and reconnaissance agency. Based in the Undercity's Rogues' Quarter, they work across Lordaeron to remove internal threats, spy on rival factions, and secure territory for the Dark Lady.
Deathstalker reports place Fenwick Thatros near a ruined dock on Lake Lordamere's shore in northeastern Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: What does completing this mission earn with the Deathstalkers?
faq.answer: Killing Fenwick Thatros proves an operative's capability and loyalty to Mennet Carkad and the Deathstalkers. Once you have shown your reliability, Carkad offers specialized training in the shadow arts.
Mennet Carkad trains rogues and handles the Deathstalkers in the Undercity's Rogues' Quarter. He oversees field agents and assigns work tied to the Forsaken realm's security.

angles.text: As a rogue, you prove your stealth and lethality through this contract before the Deathstalkers trust you with deeper tools of their trade.
As one of the Forsaken, you know rival undead factions cannot claim sovereignty so close to the Capital City. Fenwick Thatros's head is a political necessity.
